description:
Find and pre-book a guaranteed parking space for football, rugby, NFL, international matches and concerts at major UK stadiums, including Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, Wembley Stadium, Ashton Gate, Bath Rugby's Recreation Ground, Selhurst Park and the Principality Stadium.

Ask for a fixture, team, artist or venue and see upcoming events with live availability, the price for each vehicle type (car, 4x4, van or minibus), the booking fee, car park opening time, address, what3words and walking time to the ground. Tap Book to finish on matchdayparking.com or concertparking.co.uk, where you add your vehicle registration and pay securely.

All car parks are operated by Stadi Tech UK Ltd. The app only reads public availability and never asks for your name, contact details, registration or payment information in ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Find me parking for the next Spurs home game
